notes.title: NEW.PATCH.ALERT.
notes.notes:
Hello players! 

We are back from a bit of a break with a fresh new patch!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34051325/82dae5adb94a179f9556c90138f8d7c010a82eaa.gif

Here are the release notes:

Features:
 Versus mode: manager automatically imports other users’ programs 
 IF/CASE highlighting automatically selects the entire block of commands  and de-highlighting deselects the block of commands (thx @programaths)
 New AI behavior for MOVE BACK

Bug Fixes:
 Reset progress bar after CLEAR
 Minor level fixed + optimization
 Memory and speed optimization
 Changes made to the Star Requirements for the Tutorial level "I'm proud of my flag"


As always, thank you for your continued support and be on the look out for further updates!

Thank you for playing. :)

notes.title: IF.NEW.YEAR.THEN.NEW.UPDATE.
notes.notes:
Happy new year players!
As promised, here comes another update for RoboSnakes!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34051325/ca3ee558741f7047255a967ac4437898d72bc0e5.gif

Here are the release notes:

Features:

 Further improvements and optimization of tutorial levels
 Improving star requirements for various levels
 Support for multiplayer modes
 New, techno soundtrack added into the game


Bug Fixes:

 Increased frame rate in different resolutions
 Sound effect levels improved
 Fixed ray effect problems


We continue to work on adding new features into the game. All of your suggestions or comments are greatly appreciated! 

We can’t wait to see the future of RoboSnakes going into 2019!
